# AstryxBlockquote { #anylumino.AstryxBlockquote }

```python
AstryxBlockquote(text, **props)
```

Render quoted text with Astryx blockquote styling.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|---------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| text    | str    | Text content synchronized to the frontend component.                                                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Blockquote props. Useful keys: cite, className, and style. anylumino manages the quoted text content. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Blockquote>. | `{}`       |
